# The Law Offices of Peter T. Nicholl

> A full-service personal injury law firm specializing in asbestos, mesothelioma, medical malpractice, and lead paint poisoning claims across Maryland and Virginia.

Led by founding partner Peter T. Nicholl and a team of experienced attorneys, the firm serves clients in Baltimore, Maryland and surrounding jurisdictions. The firm maintains specialized practice groups in medical malpractice, asbestos litigation, lead paint poisoning, and general personal injury claims.
